conditions.arena: Soccar, default gravity/speed, one enabled car, ball isolated except impact case
conditions.input: Keyboard-style W has thr=1,pitch=1,coupledPitch=1; A/D have steer=yaw. Historical versions ignore the new origin metadata. Independent-axis cases use coupledPitch=0. These are actual solver inputs, not native browser events.
conditions.firstStableDefinition: After leaving support, actual >=3 wheels, reported ground, roofUp>.95; older one-wheel full-ground recovery is recorded separately.
conditions.limitations: Different controllers can recover by different trajectories. No screen, camera, hardware FPS or proprietary-fidelity claim is inferred. Frozen archive files are required for historical measurements.
